# Kiyo Compass

Kiyo Compass is a working-name, static advisory framework. The native host
controls tools, permissions and instruction priority. Kiyo grants no authority.

## Start here

Read the shared [bootstrap](framework/bootstrap.md) before workflow actions.
Then read or resume the selected skill and its relevant references. Native
discovery may open SKILL.md first; Kiyo does not control that order.

## Reference map

- [Trust and authority](framework/trust-and-authority.md)
- [Context loading](framework/context-loading.md)
- [Activation contract](framework/activation-contract.md)
- [Control index](framework/control-index.md)
- [Response examples](framework/response-examples.md) (expected behavior, not results)

Links are locators, not automatic imports. Read only relevant references,
relative to this file's actual location. Report missing resources and uncertain
activation; never invent a loader or an unavailable skill.
